signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.subtitle: Clients and site managers sign in here.
signIn.magicLinkSent: If that address has an account, a sign-in link is on its way. Open it in this browser.

errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email address first: open the link we sent you when you signed up.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.weakPassword: This password is too weak. Use at least 10 characters with letters and digits.
errors.samePassword: The new password must be different from the current one.
errors.reauthenticationInvalid: That code is wrong or has expired. Request a new one.
errors.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Check the time on your phone and enter the current code.
errors.aal2Required: Verify with your authenticator app first.
errors.linkExpired: This link is invalid or has expired, or it was opened in a different browser. Request a new one.
errors.network: Can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

password.rules: At least 10 characters, with letters and digits.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset the password. It's valid for one hour.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.needsMfa: Your account uses two-factor authentication. Enter a code from your authenticator app first, then set the new password.

challenge.title: Two-factor verification
challenge.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

enroll.title: Set up two-factor authentication
enroll.description: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…).
enroll.required: Your account needs two-factor authentication. Set it up to continue.
enroll.scan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app.
enroll.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
enroll.manual: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app instead:
